messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT P1 — spike in 5xx from hosted API (us-west). Error rate ~6% over last 2m. Customers getting failed generations. Link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2026-12345 — paging eng-oncall.
alex: Oncall (primary) here, seeing alerts. Starting triage. @mira are you shadowing? Can anyone confirm recent deploys to us-west?
devon: I can shadow but on a call for 15m. available after 00:50 UTC. If needed I can take deputy for 01:30-04:30 UTC.
ops-bridge-bot: deploy-bot: deploy rwi/service-gen v2.3.8 finished to us-west 16m ago (id: dpl-8892). No automatic rollback triggered.
alex: ok deploy looks correlated in time. Quick checks:
- Kibana: `status:500 AND region:us-west | stats count()` shows errors concentrated on generation endpoints /v1/generate
- Check worker queue depth: `rwctl workers list --region us-west`
- Check GPU OOM or driver logs: `kubectl -n rwi logs deploy/gen-worker -l region=us-west | tail -n 200`
sam: in eu but awake. if we need to shift traffic to us-east i can patch routing and stand by for validation. prefer a short mitigation to reduce customer impact then deeper root cause.
alex: mitigation plan (short):
1) scale up dedicated pool in us-west + add 2 extra gen-worker pods
   `rwctl scale --pool rwi-dedicated-usw --replicas +2`
2) temporary weight shift 30% traffic to us-east fallback for read-heavy routes
   `routectl set-weight --service gen-api --from region=us-west --to region=us-east --weight 30`
3) if error persists, roll back deploy dpl-8892 (manual rollback) and restore traffic
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gen-500-spike (follow steps 1-4)

alex: customer impact notes: roughly ~12k failed token responses last 60m, primary affected customers: partner-a (china-adjacent traffic through us-west), several enterprise tenants on lower tiers. No SLA breach yet but high error volume. Notify CS if mitigation extends >30m.
mira: I'll take primary handoff at 02:00 UTC (cover 02:00-06:00). alex will stay shadow until 02:15 to confirm mitigation. My phone is +1-555-0123 if pager escalates.
alex: handing off checklist to @mira: confirm error rate <1% for 10m, verify no regressions in latency, check gate for rollback actions, and post final status to #incidents. snippet for rate check:
```
# query kusto/metrics
metrics.query("sum(errors) by region,endpoint | where region=='us-west' | moving_average(10m)")
```
mira: got it. I'll do the 10m window check and watch deploy logs. devon — can you be deputy from 04:00-08:00? we might need extra eyes if we scale and rollback.
devon: yes can cover 04-08 UTC. if anything spikes again I'll jump on bridge.
sam: I pushed the weight change to 30% now and scaled 2 pods. Watching metrics, cpu/gpu usage rising but error rate dropping to ~2.1% in last 3m.
ops-bridge-bot: bridge created: https://call.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-12345
alex: good progress. I'll open a short postmortem draft and capture timestamps. @cs-ops please standby to message affected customers if we hit >30m mitigation.
pagerbot: Incident status update — severity downgraded to P2. Error rate trending down to 0.8% over last 5m. Continue monitoring.
mira: I confirm error rate <1% now for 12m. I'll keep primary and will run the canary traffic back to us-west slowly (10% increments) after 30m stable. leaving a note in runbook when complete.
alex: thanks team. final handoff: @mira primary (02:00-06:00 UTC), @devon deputy (04:00-08:00 UTC), @alex shadow until 02:15 and available for escalations. If anyone needs docs: https://redwood.internal/ops/oncall-handbook#handoffs :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup: ping me if you need the routing rollback command. I'll be around for the next hour.
mira: marking thread resolved for immediate triage; will reopen if errors reappear. posting summary to #incidents in 10m. :white_check_mark:"
